<a id="game_charset"></a>
### [`game_charset`](../../../../src/data/charset.asm#L6) `$3000-$314F`

*data*

Game character set (multicolour landscape, digits $00-$09, letters $81-$9a, panel and logo $a0-$cf, radar $d0-$ff).

### [`crater_chars`](../../../../src/data/charset.asm#L49) `$3150-$315F`

### [`radar_chars`](../../../../src/data/charset.asm#L236) `$3680-$36B6`
